p: The dasha calculator shows the Vimshottari timeline of life seasons, which starts from the nakshatra your Moon occupied at birth. The Sade Sati calculator shows when Saturn passes through the three signs around your Moon. Kundli matching compares two Moon placements across the eight Ashtakoota areas and gives a score out of 36.

Positions come from the Swiss Ephemeris, the astronomical engine behind professional astrology software. The tools use the sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsha, the standard in India, and a dasha year of 365.25 days. Your birth place is turned into a time zone so that the local birth time becomes the right moment in world time.

sections.h2: A gentle way to read the results
p: These tools describe traditional timelines and scores. Treat them as a mirror for reflection and conversation, not as a prediction of events. Where a tradition treats something as challenging, you will see it described as a theme to be aware of, together with a practical step.

dasha-calculator.title: Dasha Calculator: Free Vimshottari Dasha Online
dasha-calculator.description: Free Vimshottari dasha calculator. Enter date, time and place of birth to see your mahadasha, antardasha and the full 120-year timeline. No sign-up.
dasha-calculator.lead: See the planetary period you are in now and your whole life timeline, from your date, time and place of birth.

p: Vimshottari dasha divides a 120-year cycle among nine planets. Where the cycle begins depends on the nakshatra the Moon occupied at your birth, and how far the Moon had travelled through that nakshatra sets how much of the first period remained at birth.

The mahadasha is the major period and lasts between six and twenty years. Inside it, nine antardasha sub-periods follow the same planetary order, each led by its own planet. The tool lists both with their dates, and marks the one running today.

Each planet is shown with a theme such as growth, patience or curiosity. Use it as an invitation to notice where your attention naturally goes in each season of life, not as a forecast of what will happen.

faq.a: It is the major planetary period in the Vimshottari system. The nine periods together make a 120-year cycle, and each one is divided into nine sub-periods called antardasha.

The Moon travels about thirteen degrees a day, so a few hours can move it into a different nakshatra and shift every date in the timeline. If you do not know the time, the tool says so when the result could change.
A dasha year of 365.25 days. Other programs use slightly different year lengths, which can move dates by a few days.

faq.q: Can I get a forecast for the coming year?
faq.a: Yes. The optional report below the result lists your sub-periods for the next twelve months and a weekly forecast, with a gentle practice for each season.

sade-sati-calculator.title: Sade Sati Calculator: Check Your Saturn Season
sade-sati-calculator.description: Free Sade Sati calculator. Find out whether Saturn is passing through the signs around your Moon and see every season of your life with dates.
sade-sati-calculator.lead: Find out whether you are in your Sade Sati season, which phase it is, and when the next one begins.

p: Sade Sati is the roughly seven and a half years in which Saturn passes through the sign before your Moon sign, your Moon sign, and the sign after it. A full season comes around about once every thirty years.

The rising phase begins when Saturn enters the sign before your Moon sign. The peak is Saturn in your Moon sign. The setting phase is Saturn in the following sign. Because Saturn sometimes steps back into a sign before moving on, two phases can show overlapping dates.

Many people describe this period as one of maturity, focus and steady work. The tool presents it as a season for building routines and laying careful foundations, and the optional report adds a gentle practice for it.

faq.q: How long does Sade Sati last?
faq.a: About seven and a half years in total, with each of the three phases lasting around two and a half years.

faq.q: How do I know my Moon sign?
faq.a: Enter your date, time and place of birth and the tool works it out. It uses the sidereal zodiac, so it can differ from the Moon sign in a western horoscope.

faq.q: What if I do not know my birth time?
faq.a: The tool uses midday and tells you when the Moon changes sign during that day, because then the result could differ.
No. It is a traditional timing marker based on where Saturn is. It is best used as a prompt for reflection.

kundli-matching.title: Free Kundli Matching: Ashtakoota Guna Milan Online
kundli-matching.description: Free kundli matching by date of birth. Compare two Moon placements across the eight Ashtakoota areas for a score out of 36, with plain-language notes.
kundli-matching.lead: Enter the birth details of two people and see how their Moon placements line up across the eight traditional areas, scored out of 36.

p: Ashtakoota compares the nakshatra and sign of each person's Moon across eight areas: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot and Nadi. The areas carry from one to eight points and add up to 36.

Tradition uses 18 as a reference point. A higher total shows more areas lining up naturally, and a lower total shows more areas to nurture. It is one lens among many: values, communication and commitment shape a relationship far more than any number.

The tables for Vashya, Gana and Yoni vary a little between traditions and websites, so another site may show a slightly different total. This tool uses the common Parashari tables and explains each area in plain language.

faq.q: What does a score below 18 mean?
faq.a: It means this lens highlights more areas to nurture. No score can decide a relationship; your values, communication and commitment matter far more.

faq.q: Why do other sites show a different score?
faq.a: Some tables, such as Vashya, Gana and Yoni, differ slightly between almanacs. The method is the same, so totals can differ by a point or two.

faq.q: Who is the first and who is the second person?
faq.a: Tradition names them groom and bride because the tables were written that way. The labels only decide which table row is read, and anyone can use the tool.

faq.q: Do I need both birth times?
faq.a: The Moon moves quickly, so the time helps. If a time is missing the tool uses midday and tells you when the Moon changes nakshatra or sign that day.
